purpose: Refresh Smallcap Observatory holdings while the page is closed.
shortlist: Aditya Birla Sun Life Small Cap Fund
access: The Site uses password-only browser sign-in. Browser sessions can read holdings but cannot write them. Data reads by an updater, writes and this plan endpoint require X-Fund-Update-Key matching the UPDATE_KEY hosted secret, obtained through approved runtime secret injection. Sites service access alone does not authorize the application writer. Confirm ownership and publication through get_site; do not change the audience. Never log, persist or put credentials in a schedule prompt. If supported unattended secret access is unavailable, stop and report that prerequisite. No visitor session or connected app is needed when updater access is available.
sources: Read current snapshot.sources for exact public source URLs. Start with each fund house's official dated monthly portfolio spreadsheet or factsheet, then compare with at least one independent third-party portfolio page. If official extraction fails, require two third-party disclosures for the exact same month and retain provider_match status. Search for official disclosure pages as necessary. Websites may share feeds; do not equate matching copies with independent research.
verification: Check the top THIRTY company equities and percentages of total net assets, excluding cash, TREPS, derivatives and fund units. Verify the exact month-end and scheme. Prefer original AMC disclosures with independent corroboration. Label original-only and provider-only evidence accurately; never claim all thirty allocations are cross-checked when coverage is partial. Retain prior verified data and flag unresolved source differences. Do not use NAV dates or factsheet publication months as holdings dates.
write: GET current snapshot. Preserve immutable shortlist ids, names, monograms, colors and schedule. For each verified check set lastCheckedAt to actual check timestamp, checkStatus=checked or no_new; update holdings/date/sources/verification/notes only with supported evidence. On unresolved differences use checkStatus=conflict, retain last verified holdings, add a dated explanatory note and unmatched source. On inaccessible sources use failed and retain last verified holdings and lastCheckedAt. Set top-level checkedAt to actual run completion and concise truthful summary, including failures. POST application/json {snapshot: <complete Portfolio>, kind: 'check'}. Server records changes and history itself; supplied runs are ignored. Read GET /api/portfolio back and confirm saved checkedAt and changed figures. Saving data does not require republishing. Existing holdingsEvidence annotates expansion from full-portfolio records. Preserve it only while that same disclosure evidence still applies; replace or remove it when a newly cross-checked top-30 disclosure is imported. Never claim thirty corroborated allocations when sources only verify five.
schema: version=1; checkedAt/updatedAt ISO; schedule={enabled:boolean,time:'08:00',timezone:'Asia/Kolkata'} preserved; funds exactly the 34 scheme IDs in lib/fund-catalog.ts. Each fund retains id,name,monogram,color,verification,checkStatus,portfolioDate,lastCheckedAt,holdings:[{key:ISIN or stable security identity,name,weight:number}] exactly30 sorted descending, at least2 accurately scoped source records, notes. Legacy15-record history remains readable. Follow lib/portfolio.ts validation.
failure: On read failure do not overwrite. On transient POST failure retry the same payload once and read back before any further retry. Report inability to update without claiming the check succeeded. Never weaken Site access or use preview/local storage.
monthlyArchive: Target the preceding completed calendar month in Asia/Kolkata (for example, the 11 November 2026 run targets 31 October 2026 holdings versus 30 September). Preserve all historical snapshots. A selected month must never fall back to another month; identify pending schemes explicitly. Write the full equity comparison and top30 snapshot together, then verify monthly API reads, shared holdings, combined analysis, company search and portfolio-derived insights. Do not redate quarterly foreign ownership or company analysis just because monthly fund holdings changed.

fullPortfolio.scope: Full equity company positions, including disclosed unlisted equity, excluding cash/TREPS/debt. Compare two adjacent months using shares held, never infer purchases from allocation weight.
fullPortfolio.verification: Extract ALL company rows from official dated monthly portfolios for both months, match by ISIN and reconcile renames, splits, bonus issues and mergers before classifying changes. Cross-check with another source domain. Withhold disputed previous quantities and put the row in review; never interpret missing/inaccessible data as an exit. Preserve top-15 records separately. The basis must distinguish official_disclosures from provider_quantity_comparison. October single-source quantities are marked for review until corroborated. Prefer original workbooks when provider transcriptions conflict; retain the original number with a review flag rather than inventing a compromise. Preserve newer saved DB records during bundled imports.
fullPortfolio.payload: POST {comparison:{fundId,currentDate,previousDate,checkedAt,scope:full_equity,basis,rows:[{key,name,previousQuantity:number|null,currentQuantity:number,weight:number|null,previousWeight:number|null,note:string|null}],sources:[{label,url,scope}],notes:[string]}}. Both dates are adjacent completed month-end disclosures. Numbers are absolute share quantities, not lakh/crore-scaled values. At least two source domains are required. GET back and verify.

selection: Retain all 34 scheme IDs, names and categories in lib/fund-catalog.ts, including the ten expansion schemes and all five Helios equity schemes. No substitution or silent removal.
scopeNote: 34 schemes: 24 small-cap, seven mid-cap and three other Helios equity categories. Report per-month actual coverage; absent disclosures are pending, not exited positions.
